test_title: SSC GD Constable Previous Year Paper (Held on: 10th December 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Which pair of letters will NOT be on the opposite faces when the given sheet is folded to form a cube?

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/20371704a2b112356e0b90b523d1383999c15087caf2f01907bbe85284cecd9f.png]
solution:
Faces opposite to each other is shown below:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9960b09a43ba0bf77b2cffa2e61149c9685d8df812a1036a3e2e3624c7fce738.png] 

1. L and O → Not the opposite faces

2. M and P → Opposite faces

3. K and L → Opposite faces

4. N and O → Opposite faces

Hence, '**L and O**' is the correct answer.
